const scores = [10, 20, 30];
const point = { x: 1, y: 2 };
for (const k in point) {
  console.log(point[k]);
}
for (const i in scores) {
  const copy = i;
  console.log(scores[copy]);
}
for (const i in scores) {
  console.log(scores[i + 1]);
}
for (const i in scores) {
  const shadow = (i: string) => scores[i];
  console.log(shadow(i));
}
const both: { [key: string]: number; [index: number]: number } = { 0: 1 };
for (const i in both) {
  console.log(scores[i]);
}
const loose: any = [1, 2];
for (const i in loose) {
  console.log(scores[i]);
}
for (const i in scores) {
  console.log(i * 2);
}
let outer = "0";
for (const i in scores) {
  console.log(scores[outer]);
}
